speaker: Roberta Chen-Ramirez
cascadeSummary: With structural framing ahead of schedule, we're shifting focus to MEP rough-ins and interior build-out while maintaining seismic compliance. The second shift crew allows dusk pours to accelerate schedule without compromising OSHPD-3 standards.

statements.decision: Proceed with accelerated interior rough-in schedule while maintaining quality oversight
statements.quote: We're running two crews now—one at dawn, one at dusk—but I won't sign off on drywall until every conduit and duct meets spec. Temescal deserves systems that last.
statements.fullStatement: Structural frame installation is three days ahead of schedule with all caissons passing inspection. Starting this cycle, we're accelerating MEP rough-ins with the second shift crew—electrical conduit, plumbing stacks, and ductwork installations progressing in tandem. Our weekly quality audits will verify all systems meet OSHPD-3 requirements before interior wall closures. The contractor has committed to maintaining the accelerated pace without change orders through careful prefabrication coordination.
